title: Quick Hearty Irish Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty Irish dish featuring juicy sausage, red pepper paste, and sauteed vegetables, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Irish sausage
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high meat content

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Irish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the red pepper paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
